_comment: Client-only and 'required: true' is deliberate. There is exactly one mixin, it targets two
private GameRenderer methods whose selectors were copied from the pinned yarn javadoc rather than
from memory, and both injections are TAIL-read-and-add rather than cancellable-replace, so a
conflicting mod keeps its own FOV change.
'environment' is what keeps a dedicated server from ever resolving GameRenderer: without it the
mixin would still be applied to a client class in a server's jar and Mixin would fail on the
missing class — which 'required: true' then turns into a hard crash at launch. If a future change
makes any part of this file needed on the server, the right move is a second, server-environment
config file, not flipping 'required' to false here.
No 'plugin' key: an IMixinConfigPlugin buys acceptance-time filtering, and this mod has nothing to
filter — the mixins are unconditional and cheap. Adding one would be the place a silent
'applyName' typo turns into 'mixin not found', which is the opposite of helpful.
